verdicts.reasons: No blocking accessibility defect. The fold row is a standard summary: disclosure role, native expanded state, name 'Theme' open and 'Theme Default (shared: Void)' folded; Change stays in the band body, away from the summary, so no near-miss press folds anything and the summary's ring encloses only itself. Non-blocking: (1) open, 'Theme' is exposed three times in a row (summary, the nested region named by the hidden label, and the radiogroup), verbose for screen reader users; (2) under 300 px the d04 grid puts Change alone on a row ABOVE the name while DOM order is name then Change, so the visual and reading order differ (1.3.2 still met, a misread risk); (3) it costs the most space: open 130 px vs d04 106, folded at 160 px 53 to 73 px (three lines for Default); (4) the folded name relies on the cloned face's text (same as B, see AT03). A is the safe fallback if B's fixes are not taken.

verdicts.reasons: Best accessible naming of the three: the fold row's accessible name is its visible text and is the same open and folded ('Theme Default (shared: Void)', 'Theme Ember (set on this key)', 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void)'), only expanded changes; it is also the most compact at 200% zoom when folded. Blocking: (AT01) Change is positioned over the summary's own box, so the summary's focus ring draws around Change as well (a ring enclosing a second control), its hover fill runs under Change, and the summary surrounds Change's 24 px target on three sides with no spacing: presses 2 to 3 px outside Change fold the whole band and move the chips away (2.5.8 and 2.4.7 are met on paper, the interaction is still a trap for imprecise pointing). (AT02) the 72 px right reserve applies to every line of the summary, so at 200% zoom the name is squeezed into a 60 px column beside Change: 3 lines for 'Default (shared: Void)', 4 for an unknown theme. Both fixed and re-measured in my copy (proto-Bfix).

Change keeps its absolute position, its 44.5 x 24.8 px box, its aria-label and its DOM place after the summary. Tested in C:\Users\stephen\AppData\Local\Temp\hw-tf-a11y\proto-Bfix\com.lawrensen.hwinfo.sdPlugin\ui\a11y-fix.css.
required_changes.why: In B and C the summary's focus ring and hover fill enclose Change, and the summary's target wraps Change on three sides with no spacing, so a press 2 to 3 px beside Change folds the band and moves the chips (WCAG 2.4.7 and 2.5.8 are met by the letter; the focus indicator is ambiguous and the miss is costly).
required_changes.acceptance_test: At 373 and 320 px wide, band open, key Default: summary.getBoundingClientRect().right <= theme-change left - 4 px (Bfix: 309 vs 316.5; 256 vs 263.5); real mouse presses 3 px right, 2 px below and 3 px left of Change leave #sec-theme open (Bfix 3/3, B 0/3); with the summary focused by Tab, a capture shows the ring ending before Change; Tab order stays Open all, summary, Change, checked chip; Change still reveals the Shared theme select.

required_changes.change: Under 300 px (200% zoom), take Change out of the row instead of reserving 72 px beside every line of the name: @media (max-width: 299px) { details.hw-look-fold[open] > summary.hw-look-name { margin-right: 0; padding-right: var(--hw-gutter); } details.hw-look-fold .hw-look-change { position: static; margin: -4px -2px -4px auto; } details.hw-look-fold > summary.hw-look-name .hw-look-current { flex: 1 1 60px; } }. Change then sits on its own line between the summary and the chips (same DOM and visual order), right-aligned, and keeps its place invisibly on an explicit pick as in d04.
required_changes.why: B's 72 px reserve squeezes the name into a 60 px column at 160 px (3 lines for Default, 4 for an unknown theme) and AT01's margin would squeeze it further; low-vision users at 200% zoom pay the most for wasted height (WCAG 1.4.10 intent).
required_changes.acceptance_test: At 189 x 410 and 160 x 410, DPR 1.5, open: Change's box does not intersect the summary's box; summary height <= 42 px for 'Theme Default (shared: Void)' (Bfix 41.6, B 59.7/76.5) and <= 60 px for an unknown theme at 160 (Bfix 58.4, B 93.3); document scrollWidth equals clientWidth; Tab order Open all, summary, Change, checked chip; with the 1.4.12 text-spacing override at 189 the name and Change do not overlap (Bfix: no overlap).

required_changes.change: Make the row's text the one source of its accessible name. In proto.js keep the cloned face aria-hidden (drop face.removeAttribute("aria-hidden")). In proto-B.css, folded with a chip, hide #theme-current > span:first-child with the clip pattern (position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap) instead of display: none. The link glyph stays aria-hidden inside the clone.
required_changes.why: The prototype builds the folded name from the clone's drawn text, so the name silently follows whatever the chip face draws (it once drew a sample value); tying it to #theme-current keeps the name equal to the line the open band shows. Label-in-name (2.5.3) still holds because the chip shows the same word.
required_changes.acceptance_test: For key Default, key Ember, Paper shared, empty key, unknown stored theme and dial Ember, folded and open, the summary's AX name equals 'Theme ' + #theme-current textContent (Bfix MEASURED: 'Theme Default (shared: Void)', 'Theme Ember (set on this key)', 'Theme Default (shared: Paper)', 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void)', 'Theme Ember (set on this dial)'); the AX subtree of #theme-mini has no StaticText; changing the shared theme in Advanced while folded updates the name to '(shared: Ember)' and the chip to Ember colors (Bfix MEASURED).

required_changes.change: In the shell's panelFolds handler (pi-shell.js, the loop that sets section.open from the answer), once the sections have been revealed by the 300 ms timeout, never fold a section that contains document.activeElement (optionally: never apply a late answer at all after the reveal). Owner's call, because it touches how folds are applied for every section, not how they are kept.
required_changes.why: With a slow plugin the band appears open at the 300 ms cap and the late answer then folds it; in A and C the chips drew about 200 ms before the fold (130 to 35 px and 113 to 41 px jumps). As the first section, the band's move is the largest and a focused chip would be dropped to the body. Pre-existing for all sections, made more visible by folding the first one.

With a prompt plugin the remembered fold still applies before the first visible paint (hw-folds-answer mark before any visible sample).

answers.q1_variant: B with AT01 and AT02 (blocking), plus AT03 and AT04. For assistive technology B already answers 'what is drawn and where does it come from' in both states: the fold row's accessible name is its visible text and stays the same open and folded, only the expanded state changes (MEASURED: 'Theme Default (shared: Void)', 'Theme Ember (set on this key)', 'Theme Default (shared: Paper)', 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void)', 'Theme Ember (set on this dial)'). A's open row says only 'Theme' and leaves the answer to a static line and the radiogroup description. Sighted users get the same words plus the chip in its own palette with Default's dashed frame and link mark. B's two real defects are geometric (Change inside the summary's ring and target, and the name squeezed at zoom) and my copy proto-Bfix fixes both with CSS alone. A is approvable as is and is the fallback; C has B's defects plus the tallest zoomed fold (75 to 76 px at 160).
answers.q2_fold_all: Include the band. MEASURED in A, B and C: Fold all, Open all and Alt-click on another section title fold and open #sec-theme with the rest, the plugin memory keeps sec-theme beside the other nine ids (10, under the 12-per-kind bound), and the toolbar's aria-disabled states stay correct. The shell announces 'All sections folded' / 'All sections open' and computes aria-disabled over every section; a disclosure that looks and behaves like the others but is skipped would make that announcement untrue and the pattern inconsistent (WH, consistent behavior in the spirit of WCAG 3.2.4). Nothing the owner requires is lost: folded, the row still names and shows the resolved theme.
answers.q3_hidden_until_answer: Acceptable. MEASURED on the sim: with a prompt plugin the fold answer lands 21 to 28 ms after navigation start and the chips 20 to 27 ms, the same round trip, so hiding the band costs no visible time compared with d04 (whose band showed only a bare 38 px line until the chips came). While hidden the band is visibility: hidden, so it is out of the accessibility tree and nothing is announced and then withdrawn. With a slow plugin (600 ms) the band shows at the 300 ms cap (320 to 336 ms) as a bare 46 px row and the late answer then folds it (all three variants; in A and C the chips drew about 200 ms first). That late re-fold is pre-existing shell behavior for every section, largest for the first one: AT05, non-blocking. A plugin that never connects keeps the 1.5 s cap, as today.
answers.q4_accessibility: Folded, the row must be the native summary (Chromium role DisclosureTriangle, exposed as a button with expanded=false) whose accessible name equals its visible text: 'Theme', the resolved name, and the scope, e.g. 'Theme Default (shared: Void), collapsed'; for an unknown stored theme 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void)'; on an empty key the added note (AT04). The cloned chip and its link glyph should be aria-hidden with the name coming from #theme-current (AT03). No live region is needed: the native expanded state is spoken on toggle. The extra Tab stop is justified: the APG Disclosure pattern needs a focusable button, every other section has one, and folding repays it (MEASURED Tab counts: to the checked chip 3 to 4 for Default and 2 to 3 for an explicit theme; folded, to the Reading title 4 to 3 for Default and 3 to 3 for explicit). Keyboard: Enter folds and Space opens with focus kept on the summary, both remembered (MEASURED). Focus: 2 px ring on the summary (inset) and on Change, but in B and C the summary's ring also encloses Change until AT01. Radiogroup: name 'Theme' and description unchanged from d04 in all variants (MEASURED); B and C drop d04's region landmark 'Theme' (acceptable, the summary is the first stop), A keeps it and says 'Theme' three times. Forced colors: chip faces, clone included, keep their real colors (forced-color-adjust: none), the triangle is CanvasText, the ring stays visible (MEASURED). Reduced motion: the triangle's 0.12 s turn becomes 0 s; nothing else animates (MEASURED).
answers.q5_edge_states: No reading picked (key-empty): all variants show the Default chip in the shared palette on the folded row while the key face is the black 'Pick a sensor' prompt; the explaining help and the radiogroup description that carries it are inside the fold, so folded users of any kind lose it: AT04 (Bfix: note on a second line, 46 px row at 373, included in the name). Unknown stored theme: no chip is checked so no mini is drawn; every variant falls back to the text row '"neon" (unknown; draws Void)', which still names the resolved theme (MEASURED); keep the long help out of the folded row (my trial mirroring it made the row 57 px at 373 and 123 px at 160). Paper shared theme: the mini Default chip is a light face with dark text (15.0:1) and a #4A4740 dashed frame, clearly bounded on the dark panel; in forced colors it keeps its real colors (MEASURED bg rgb(233,230,222)); chip text contrast ranges 12.2:1 (Ember) to 21:1 (Void) across all eight themes (computed from themes.json). Shared theme changed in Advanced while folded: name and chip update live to '(shared: Ember)' (MEASURED, Bfix). 200% zoom: no horizontal overflow in any variant at 189 or 160 and no fold-row overlap or clipping under the 1.4.12 text-spacing override (MEASURED; the gallery chips truncate to 'Defa...' under that override, pre-existing d04). Folded height at 160: A 53 to 73, B 49 to 50, C 75 to 76, Bfix 47.8 px. Open at 160: B squeezes the name to a 60 px column (summary 76.5 px, 93.3 for unknown) until AT02 (Bfix 41.6 / 58.4); A puts Change alone on a row above the name.

keep: Native details/summary for the fold: role, expanded state and Enter/Space toggling come for free and were MEASURED correct in all variants; no ARIA re-implementation.
B's summary content: 'Theme', the resolved name and the scope inside the summary, so its accessible name is the same open and folded and only the expanded state changes.
Change's DOM place right after the summary, its aria-label 'Change the shared theme' (label in name holds) and its 44.5 x 24.8 px box.
The radiogroup exactly as in d04: one Tab stop on the checked chip, arrow keys, Home and End, name 'Theme' from #theme-label, description theme-desc + theme-help.
The mini chip's width: auto, so it never truncates under the 1.4.12 text-spacing override (MEASURED 85.9 px), unlike the gallery chips.
forced-color-adjust: none on .hw-theme-face (covers the clone), CanvasText triangle, and the reduced-motion rule that removes the triangle's transition.
Including sec-theme in Open all, Fold all and Alt-click and in the per-kind fold memory (10 ids, inside the 12 bound).
The text-only fallback when no chip is checked (unknown stored theme).
